Leah (Sales): passing Bluestone Analytics to CS — signed 1yr, 100 seats, private deploy us-east-1. main asks: low-latency gen for short replies, SAML SSO, Splunk audit logs, and a migration window in Sept. flagged renewal sensitivity if perf doesn't meet expectations.

Priya (CS): thanks Leah. assigning Diego as CSM. quick ask: what's the current provisioning status and any infra constraints? will create runbook and standing weekly sync.

Leah (Sales): legal and billing done. infra started. Pending: VPC peering, customer-provided certs, KMS rotation policy, and Splunk HEC endpoint. They requested a dedicated GPU pool for peak hours.

Diego (CSM): i'll own the onboarding runbook. proposed timeline: 1) network & auth (this week), 2) ingest audit logs + SSO (week of 6/24), 3) perf pilot with their key prompts (week of 7/1), 4) go-live weekend 7/8. Acceptance: SSO live, Splunk receives JSON-lines events, median latency <300ms on their 8 primary prompts under pilot load.

OnboardBot: provisioning update — VPC created; private control plane queued. Remaining tasks: vpn+peering, certs, firewall, KMS policy, Splunk endpoint. 4/9 complete.

Rae (Eng): saw their demo transcript Leah attached — stalls at ~600 tokens on streaming. need request_ids to correlate with kernel logs. short-term recommendations: try redwood-medium-quant for pilot, enable prefix cache for their template, and reserve a small dedicated pool for peak windows.

Omar (Support): opening CS ticket CS-4999 and adding ENG triage label. please paste sanitized prompt and any request_id values. I'll watch for reproducible traces.

Leah (Sales): sanitized log snippet: `2024-06-20T12:11:02Z request_id=bs-20240620-1 model=redwood-large seq=610 latency=1300ms step=kv_fetch stream_event=stall duration=1600ms`

Rae (Eng): thanks — can Bluestone run the curl below from their env and paste back the response header request_id? we need that to pull host traces.

```
curl -X POST https://private.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <PROV_KEY>" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"<their-long-prompt>","stream":true}' -D - | head
```

Diego (CSM): action owners: Priya — schedule weekly syncs; Diego — runbook + training; Rae — triage ENG ticket (due 6/26); Omar — own CS-4999; Leah — deliver sanitized prompts & request_ids; Infra/OnboardBot — finish peering & certs.

Priya (CS): capturing enablement asks: 1) one-page quickstart for private deploy, 2) quantization tradeoffs doc for their architects, 3) runbook template for SSO + Splunk mapping. Bluestone wants the one-pager before pilot.

Omar (Support): CS-4999 created and priority=high. watchers: @Rae @Diego. linking ENG-xxx when available.

Rae (Eng): preliminary config suggestion: redwood-medium-quant + prefix cache for template, increase stream socket timeout to 60s, and validate dedicated pool sizing. will post config diff after repro.

Leah (Sales): Bluestone also requested audit fields: request_id, user_id, token_counts, model, latency in JSON-lines. Diego — can you confirm field mapping with infra?

Diego (CSM): will validate Splunk HEC mapping — Priya pls get the endpoint & a test key. we'll run an ingestion smoke test before pilot.

OnboardBot: VPN + peering complete. firewall PR awaiting netops approval. Splunk HEC test pending.

Priya (CS): scheduling initial weekly sync for next Tue and inviting eng lead for first two meetings. marking this as renewal-risk=monitor until pilot passes latency acceptance.

Leah (Sales): thanks all — i'll upload sanitized prompts to the runbook and sync with legal on audit SLA language. :thumbsup:

Diego (CSM): i'll post the runbook link here once ready and close the handoff. reopen if blockers pop up before go-live.
